text:
priya: Heads-up — opening a docs PR that adds an HSM failover test checklist and an airgapped RPM mirror example to the Private installer guide. Will include a tiny PKCS#11 snippet for the SDK.

matt: thanks — can you add a quick preflight checklist for the mirror (ports, certs, checksum)? we keep getting questions about curl vs yum paths.

priya: yup. thinking something like: 1) ensure outbound access to S3 for initial sync (or scp in airgap) 2) open TCP 443/80 for mirror clients 3) verify repo GPG and sha256 checksums.

lia: pkcs11 snippet for docs — feel free to use this minimal example: 

```
# /etc/pkcs11/redwood.conf
module = /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
slot = 0
pin = 1234
label = "redwood-hsm"

# SDK env (bash)
export PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
export HSM_PIN=1234
```

lia: also add note: do NOT commit real pins or PEMs. use placeholder values in examples.

jordan: on the RPM mirror: include both dnf/yum layout and a curl-based fallback. tiny example command: 

```bash
# rsync local mirror from builder host
rsync -av --delete /builder/rpms/ /var/www/html/repo/
createrepo_c /var/www/html/repo/
# then serve via nginx on 443 with cert from vault
```

jordan: and a short troubleshooting bullet: "yum fails — check repomd.xml GPG signature and repo permissions"

priya: thanks, I'm going to push the PR now. tagging @matt and @lia for review. will add a small migration note for existing customers: how to switch from remote repo to local mirror with minimal downtime.

matt: quick ask — can we include a single screenshot of the nginx location config? tiny cropped image. docs-bot will handle uploads if you attach when you open the PR.

priya: will do. screenshot + one-liner explaining SELinux context (chcon -t httpd_sys_content_t).

lia: one more SDK note: call out the middleware retry behaviour when HSM is temporarily unreachable. add snippet for exponential backoff in our python sdk sample: 

```python
# pseudo-code retry wrapper
def call_with_hsm_retry(fn):
    for i in range(5):
        try:
            return fn()
        except HSMTransientError:
            sleep(2 ** i)
    raise
```

priya: perfect. I'll also add a short test matrix and an example smoke test command for teams to validate HSM switchover.

docs-bot: Preview for PR #1234: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (built preview available). :eyes:

matt: looks good. If the preview shows layout issues ping me and I can help tidy CSS. :thumbsup:

priya: thanks — will ping after CI. planning to merge tomorrow afternoon if no blockers.

jordan: FYI I fixed a broken link to the "offline bundle checksums" doc in a separate commit — no conflict expected.

priya: awesome. merging plan: squash commits, add changelog note under Private -> Installer -> Airgapped mirrors.

matt: cool. thanks everyone.
